content: When Mirror_ReportLinFrame is called to report a re- ceived or transmitted LIN frame, the Bus Mirroring module shall extract the frame ID from the reported pid and match it against all active statically configured and dynam- ically added filters of the corresponding source bus. If the LIN frame matches at least one filter, it is accepted by the Bus Mirroring module.
